raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-16 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver mixes the two. v2 rows are therefore 6 hours ahead (CST), so evening Chicago transactions land in 00:00-06:00 and spill into the next date, which explains the 2026-01-19 rows. Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago local time (UTC-6 in January) before deriving txn_ts and txn_date fixes silver, and the gold tables follow from it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, adj_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(adj_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS adj_ts FROM raw_transactions) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
